goal: Explain why this program, why this university, why Germany, and how the program fits your academic and career path.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and the exact program you want to study.
Summarize relevant education, performance, projects, and skills.
Show practical preparation that supports the program.
Explain specific modules, specialization, research direction, or academic strengths.
Mention faculty, labs, courses, structure, or reputation only when relevant.
Explain the academic, research, or professional value of studying in Germany.
Describe realistic short-term and long-term goals after completion.
Restate your motivation briefly and professionally.

structure_rules: Be reflective, not dramatic. Be factual, not promotional.
Do not repeat your CV line by line.
red_flags: Generic praise of Germany or the university
Copying content from the university website
Weak explanation of why this program fits your background
preferred_language: My academic background has prepared me for...
This program aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum offers the specialization I need in...
This university provides the resources relevant to...
After completing the program, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The motivation is specific and university fit is clear
The Germany rationale is academic and practical
The tone is formal and reflective
